# NextClasses.in

> NextClasses.in is an Indian online learning platform operated by Fetecart Store in Thrissur, Kerala. It offers self-paced courses, student study portals, practice materials and course-aware learning support.

Canonical website: https://www.nextclasses.in/
About: https://www.nextclasses.in/about/
Course catalogue: https://www.nextclasses.in/#courses
Learning guides: https://www.nextclasses.in/resources/
Support: support@nextclasses.in
Phone and WhatsApp: +91 87921 34951

## Course areas

- Generative AI, ChatGPT, Google AI Studio, Claude, AI agents, automation, coding and AI media
- Spoken English, French, German and public speaking
- UPSC Civil Services foundations, SSC CGL and Kerala PSC degree-level common preliminary preparation: INR 1,999 each (compare-at INR 4,999)
- Other state PSC tracks: coming soon; not available for enrolment
- NEET, JEE, KEAM, AISSEE Sainik School and Navodaya preparation
- Computer-based mock tests, scheduled study materials and digital learning resources

## Student experience

- Enrollment and payment are completed through the official website.
- Enrolled students use a private student portal for their assigned courses and materials.
- Course questions can be answered by a course-aware AI voice mentor inside the portal.
- Course availability, current prices and syllabus details should be verified on the canonical website.
